summary: Umatilla NF 60-ft timber tower (1936) at 5,218 ft; cab blew off 2007-08, ground cabin burned 2009; abandoned; still standing per FFLA list; accessible by forest road walk.

facts.design: 60-ft treated timber tower with 7x7-ft cab and ground cabin (FFLOS, firelookout.com); a 1936 letter gives 66 ft
facts.status_note: Tower stands with its cab gone (firelookout.org). The cab blew off in 2007-08 and the ground cabin burned in 2009. Abandoned by the Forest Service per a 2012 visit; no later check found.

access.note: CherylHill's table lists it as accessible to the public. Forest roads reach the site; a 2012 visit parked on Road 3128 and walked the spur.

visit.trail_note: Long drive up Skyline Road (Road 31), then park on Road 3128 and walk up the spur (2012 visit). Tower is abandoned and in poor shape. The advice not to climb it is editorial, not from a source.

events.note: Built 1936 (register, firelookout.com); 66-ft ring-connected tower erected in 36 man days with CCC labor (October 1936 letter)
Changed from an Emergency Lookout to a regular Lookout-Fireman position
Used for emergency detection in the 1970s (register); exact start year not recorded
Tower cab blew over in 2008 (register, firelookout.com); CherylHill's 2012 visit dates it to the winter of 2007-08
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on August 19, 2011
Abandoned by the Forest Service per a 2012 visit; date of abandonment not given

corrections.why: The FFLOS register and firelookout.com both describe a 60-foot tower, about 18.3 m. No source supports 2.1 m. Sources also give 66 ft (1936 letter) and 100 ft (1963 data sheet).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 60 ft in the register and firelookout.com; 66 ft in a 1936 letter; 100 ft in a 1963 USGS data sheet reproduced on Rex's page. Not resolved. height_m uses the 60-ft figure from two modern listings.
firelookout.org lists the tower as Standing* (cab gone). CherylHill's 2012 post and table both say Abandoned, not standing as the brief's conflicts list said. Not resolved; no later visit found.
The register and firelookout.com say the cab blew over in 2008; CherylHill's 2012 visit says it blew off in the winter of 2007-08. Not resolved; the story gives both.
The register and firelookout.org give 45.58912, -118.20925. The brief's other source (west_us_lookouts, 45.61097, -118.21884) was not checked here. The register point is used.

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees across sources (60, 66, 100 ft); the brief's 2.1 m was wrong and is corrected to 18.3 m. Brief's cherylhill=standing claim is wrong: the 2012 post and table both say Abandoned. Cab-loss year differs (2007-08 vs 2008). The brief's alternate coordinate (west_us_lookouts) was not checked. Status rests on the undated firelookout.org list and a 2012 visit; no later check found. Staffing 'abandoned' as_of 2012 is from the CherylHill table. No new photos added. Access 'public' is the CherylHill table's accessibility column; the tower itself is abandoned and the story advises against climbing.
